Re-pointed from Concise on retirement, 2026-09-22: Matthew Henry's Concise Commentary (entry ROM.8.28-31.mhcc.9e98c639, 'That is good for the saints...Whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate...') was retired in favor of the unabridged Complete Commentary; this is verified as the same passage in Henry's own words, which the Concise had abridged — Henry's Complete calls it 'the order of the causes of our salvation, a golden chain' over Rom 8:29-30, immediately following a separate 26-28 section and preceding a separate 31-39 section (his Complete divides this discourse differently than the Concise did, so 29-30 is the closest single entry to the old 28-31 span, not an exact match).
